ucs.title: [LLM] RansomHub EDRKillShifter BYOVD — vulnerable driver loaded + EDR/AV process termination
ucs.description: Hunts RansomHub's signature pre-encryption tradecraft: the EDRKillShifter loader (and its TDSSKiller-style variants) dropping a vulnerable signed driver (RentDrv2/ksapi64/Toshiba dBHelper/Avast aswArPot etc.), registering it as a kernel service, then killing AV/EDR user-mode processes immediately before file encryption. The driver-load → service-create → security-process-terminate chain in a tight window is highly characteristic of RansomHub affiliate intrusions (CISA AA24-242A; Microsoft Threat Intelligence: 'Manatee Tempest' / overlap with Scattered Spider affiliates).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as process values(Processes.process_name) as proc_name from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="sc.exe" OR Processes.process="*New-Service*" OR Processes.process="*sc create*" by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name _time span=5m | rename Processes.* as * | join type=inner dest [ | tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name IN ("RentDrv2.sys","ksapi64.sys","aswArPot.sys","dbutil_2_3.sys","truesight.sys","viragt64.sys","DBUtilDrv2.sys","PROCEXP152.sys","echo_driver.sys","TfSysMon.sys")) OR (Filesystem.file_path="*\\Windows\\Temp\\*" AND Filesystem.file_name="*.sys") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.process_id | rename Filesystem.* as *] | join type=inner dest [ | tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("taskkill.exe","net.exe","sc.exe","powershell.exe") AND Processes.process IN ("*MsMpEng*","*MsSense*","*SenseIR*","*windefend*","*WdNisSvc*","*Sophos*","*CSFalconService*","*ekrn*","*SentinelAgent*","*xagt*","*ccSvcHst*") by Processes.dest Processes.process | rename Processes.* as *] | where lastTime - firstTime < 600 | table firstTime lastTime dest user parent_process_name proc_name process file_name | sort 0 -lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMinutes = 10m;
let VulnDrivers = dynamic(["rentdrv2.sys","ksapi64.sys","aswarpot.sys","dbutil_2_3.sys","truesight.sys","viragt64.sys","dbutildrv2.sys","procexp152.sys","echo_driver.sys","tfsysmon.sys","gmer.sys"]);
let EdrProcs = dynamic(["msmpeng","mssense","senseir","windefend","wdnissvc","sophos","csfalconservice","csagent","ekrn","sentinelagent","xagt","ccsvchst","mcshield","avp.exe","cybereason"]);
let DriverDrops = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName endswith ".sys"
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\Windows\Temp\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\")
          or tolower(FileName) in (VulnDrivers)
    | project DropTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DroppedDriver = FileName, DropPath = FolderPath,
              DropProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DropCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              DropUser = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
let EdrKills = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("taskkill.exe","sc.exe","net.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wmic.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (EdrProcs)
          or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(stop-service|stop-process|taskkill\s+/F.*sense|sc\s+(stop|delete)\s+\w*(sense|defend|falcon|sentinel))"
    | project KillTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              KillCmd = ProcessCommandLine, KillProc = FileName,
              KillUser = AccountName;
DriverDrops
| join kind=inner EdrKills on DeviceId
| where KillTime between (DropTime .. DropTime + WindowMinutes)
| where DropUser !endswith "$" and DropUser !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', KillTime, DropTime)
| project DropTime, KillTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, DropUser,
          DroppedDriver, DropPath, DropProc, DropCmd, KillCmd
| order by DropTime desc

ucs.title: [LLM] RansomHub Rclone exfiltration to MEGA / cloud storage prior to encryption
ucs.description: Hunts RansomHub's consistent double-extortion staging: Rclone (often renamed) executed with --config and a remote pointing at MEGA, Backblaze B2, Amazon S3, or pCloud, copying large file volumes outbound. RansomHub and its affiliates (incl. crossover with ALPHV/BlackCat operators per Mandiant + Symantec reporting) almost universally use Rclone with mega: or s3: remotes immediately before triggering encryption — this is one of the highest-fidelity pre-encryption signals for the actor.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.process_name) as proc_names values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents values(Processes.user) as users from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process IN ("*rclone*","*--config*","*copy *mega:*","*copy *b2:*","*copy *s3:*","*copy *pcloud:*","*--transfers*","*--multi-thread-streams*","*--no-check-certificate*") OR Processes.process_name="rclone.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user _time span=1h | rename Processes.* as * | search cmdlines IN ("*mega:*","*b2:*","*s3:*","*pcloud:*","*ftp:*","*sftp:*") AND cmdlines IN ("*copy*","*sync*","*move*") | where NOT match(user, "(?i)(\$$|system|local service|network service)") | join type=outer dest [| tstats summariesonly=true sum(All_Traffic.bytes_out) as bytes_out values(All_Traffic.dest) as remote_ip values(All_Traffic.dest_port) as ports from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest_port IN (443,80,21,22) by All_Traffic.src _time span=1h | rename All_Traffic.src as dest] | where bytes_out > 524288000 OR isnull(bytes_out) | table firstTime lastTime dest users parents proc_names cmdlines bytes_out remote_ip | sort 0 -lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let RcloneIndicators = dynamic(["--config","mega:"," b2:"," s3:","pcloud:","ftp:","sftp:","--transfers","--multi-thread-streams","--no-check-certificate","--bwlimit","--max-age"]);
let CloudExfilDomains = dynamic(["mega.nz","mega.co.nz","userstorage.mega.co.nz","backblazeb2.com","b2.backblazeb2.com","pcloud.com","api.pcloud.com","transfer.sh","anonfiles.com","gofile.io","send.exploit.in"]);
let RcloneProcs = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (FileName =~ "rclone.exe")
        or (ProcessCommandLine has_any (RcloneIndicators) and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("copy","sync","move"))
        or (SHA256 in ((externaldata(SHA256:string) [@"https://example.invalid/rclone-hashes.csv"] with(format="csv")))) // optional IOC list
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("mega:"," b2:"," s3:","pcloud:","ftp:","sftp:")
         or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","explorer.exe")
    | project ExecTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ExecImage = FolderPath, ExecCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine, SHA256;
let NetEgress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RemoteUrl has_any (CloudExfilDomains)
         or InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "rclone.exe"
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | summarize ConnCount = count(),
                Destinations = make_set(RemoteUrl, 20),
                FirstConn = min(Timestamp),
                LastConn = max(Timestamp)
                by DeviceId, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
RcloneProcs
| join kind=inner NetEgress on DeviceId
| where LastConn between (ExecTime .. ExecTime + 6h)
| project ExecTime, DeviceName, AccountName, Parent, ExecCmd,
          Destinations, ConnCount, FirstConn, LastConn, SHA256
| order by ExecTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let RcloneIndicators = dynamic(["--config","mega:"," b2:"," s3:","pcloud:","ftp:","sftp:","--transfers","--multi-thread-streams","--no-check-certificate","--bwlimit"]);
let CloudExfilDomains = dynamic(["mega.nz","mega.co.nz","backblazeb2.com","pcloud.com","transfer.sh","anonfiles.com","gofile.io"]);
let RcloneProcs = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\rclone.exe"
         or (CommandLine has_any (RcloneIndicators) and CommandLine has_any ("copy","sync","move"))
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | where SubjectUserName !in~ ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE")
    | where CommandLine has_any ("mega:"," b2:"," s3:","pcloud:","ftp:","sftp:")
    | project ExecTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
              NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName;
let NetEgress = CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where DestinationHostName has_any (CloudExfilDomains)
         or RequestURL has_any (CloudExfilDomains)
         or ProcessName endswith "rclone.exe"
    | summarize TotalBytes = sum(toint(SentBytes)),
                ConnCount = count(),
                Destinations = make_set(DestinationHostName, 20),
                FirstConn = min(TimeGenerated),
                LastConn = max(TimeGenerated)
                by Computer = SourceHostName;
RcloneProcs
| join kind=inner NetEgress on Computer
| where LastConn between (ExecTime .. ExecTime + 6h)
| where TotalBytes > 524288000 or ConnCount > 100   // 500MB or sustained streaming
| project ExecTime, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName,
          CommandLine, Destinations, TotalBytes, ConnCount, LastConn
| order by ExecTime desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: RansomHub Rclone Exfiltration to Cloud Storage
id: 7c4a9f0d-b6e2-4a3a-9b1f-rh01-rclone
description: Detects Rclone (commonly renamed) executed with cloud-remote arguments (mega:/b2:/s3:/pcloud:) characteristic of RansomHub pre-encryption exfiltration.
status: experimental
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/11
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-242a
  - https://news.sophos.com/en-us/2024/08/14/ransomhub-affiliate-exfil/
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\rclone.exe'
  selection_cmd_args:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '--config'
      - '--transfers'
      - '--multi-thread-streams'
      - '--no-check-certificate'
      - '--bwlimit'
  selection_cmd_remotes:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'mega:'
      - ' b2:'
      - ' s3:'
      - 'pcloud:'
      - 'ftp:'
      - 'sftp:'
  selection_cmd_verbs:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'copy '
      - 'sync '
      - 'move '
  filter_machine_acct:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: (selection_image or (selection_cmd_args and selection_cmd_remotes and selection_cmd_verbs)) and not filter_machine_acct
falsepositives:
  - Sysadmins legitimately using rclone for backup (rare, baseline)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.exfiltration
  - attack.t1567.002
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
  - threat.ransomhub
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) @EventID:(1 OR 4688) (@Image:(*\\rclone.exe OR *\\RClone.exe OR *\\RCLONE.EXE) OR @CommandLine:(*--config* AND (*mega\:* OR *\ b2\:* OR *\ s3\:* OR *pcloud\:* OR *ftp\:* OR *sftp\:*) AND (*copy\ * OR *sync\ * OR *move\ *))) -@User:*$ -@SubjectUserName:(SYSTEM OR "LOCAL SERVICE" OR "NETWORK SERVICE")
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\rclone\.exe$/i OR (regex("--config", field=CommandLine) AND regex("(mega:|\\sb2:|\\ss3:|pcloud:|ftp:|sftp:)", field=CommandLine) AND regex("\\b(copy|sync|move)\\b", field=CommandLine)))
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| NOT UserName=/^(SYSTEM|LOCAL SERVICE|NETWORK SERVICE)$/i
| join({#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/(mega\.nz|mega\.co\.nz|backblazeb2\.com|pcloud\.com|transfer\.sh|anonfiles\.com|gofile\.io)$/i}, field=aid, include=[DomainName])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=[count(), collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine, DomainName])])
ucs.rationale: Mandiant, Symantec Threat Hunter Team, Sophos X-Ops and CISA AA24-242A all flag Rclone-to-MEGA as the staple RansomHub exfiltration step — the affiliate playbook (shared with ex-ALPHV operators after the Feb 2024 exit-scam) consistently shows rclone.exe (often renamed svchost.exe / msupdate.exe / winrar64.exe) invoked with a remote prefix mega:/b2:/pcloud: and high --transfers/--multi-thread-strea

`NetEgress` is not a canonical column of DeviceProcessEvents.
`ExecTime` is not a canonical column of DeviceProcessEvents.
`Parent` is not a canonical column of DeviceProcessEvents.
